mapper.select:
select t.id, t.avatar, t.nick_name, t.sex, t.birth_date, t.birth_date as birthFormatDate, t.height, t.personal_photo, t.id_auth, uv.num as browseCount, t.lately_time, t.create_time, t.city
,CASE WHEN t.lon IS NOT NULL AND t.lat IS NOT NULL THEN ST_Distance_Sphere( POINT(#{lon}, #{lat}), POINT(t.lon, t.lat) ) ELSE NULL END AS distance
from user_visit uv left join t_user t on uv.visit_user_id = t.id where t.del_flag = 0 and uv.del_flag = 0 and t.`status` = 'ENABLE' and uv.user_id = #{ownerId} order by uv.modify_time desc
select count(1) from user_visit uv left join t_user t on uv.visit_user_id = t.id where t.del_flag = 0 and uv.del_flag = 0 and t.`status` = 'ENABLE' and uv.user_id = #{ownerId}
select count(1) from user_visit uv left join t_user t on uv.user_id = t.id where t.del_flag = 0 and uv.del_flag = 0 and t.`status` = 'ENABLE' and uv.visit_user_id = #{ownerId}

select t.id, t.avatar, t.nick_name, t.sex, t.birth_date, t.birth_date as birthFormatDate, t.height, t.personal_photo, t.id_auth, uv.num as browseCount, uv.status as visitStatus, uv.id as visitId, t.lately_time, t.create_time, t.city
,CASE WHEN t.lon IS NOT NULL AND t.lat IS NOT NULL THEN ST_Distance_Sphere( POINT(#{lon}, #{lat}), POINT(t.lon, t.lat) ) ELSE NULL END AS distance
from user_visit uv left join t_user t on uv.user_id = t.id where t.del_flag = 0 and uv.del_flag = 0 and t.`status` = 'ENABLE' and uv.visit_user_id = #{ownerId} order by uv.modify_time desc, uv.id desc

select t.id, t.avatar, t.nick_name, t.sex, t.birth_date, t.birth_date as birthFormatDate, t.height, t.home_town, t.residential_city, t.job_mes, t.salarys, t.wechat, t.self_description, t.personal_photo, t.ideal_friend, t.id_auth, t.edu_auth, t.school, t.education from user_apply uv left join t_user t on uv.apply_user_id = t.id where t.del_flag = 0 and uv.del_flag = 0 and t.`status` = 'ENABLE' and uv.user_id = #{ownerId} order by uv.modify_time desc
select count(1) from user_apply uv left join t_user t on uv.apply_user_id = t.id where t.del_flag = 0 and uv.del_flag = 0 and t.`status` = 'ENABLE' and uv.user_id = #{ownerId}
select count(1) as value, case fu.sex when '男' then '男' when '女' then '女' else '其他' end as name from t_user fu group by fu.sex, fu.del_flag, fu.user_type having fu.del_flag = 0 and fu.user_type = '1'
select count(1) as value, ifnull(fu.city,'其他') as name from t_user fu group by fu.city, fu.del_flag, fu.user_type having fu.del_flag = 0 and fu.user_type = '1' order by count(1) desc limit 10

select count(1) as value, DATE_FORMAT(fu.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as name from (select fu.create_time from t_user fu where fu.del_flag = 0 and fu.user_type = '1'
and DATE_FORMAT(fu.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %T')>= DATE_FORMAT(#{createTimeStart}, '%Y-%m-%d 00:00:00')
and DATE_FORMAT(fu.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %T')<= DATE_FORMAT(#{createTimeEnd}, '%Y-%m-%d 23:59:59')
) fu group by DATE_FORMAT(fu.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by DATE_FORMAT(fu.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') asc
select tu.id from t_user tu where tu.del_flag = 0 and tu.`status` = 'ENABLE' and tu.lately_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 60 DAY) order by tu.create_time asc,tu.id asc

select ua.id from user_apply ua left join t_user tu on tu.id = ua.apply_user_id where ua.del_flag = 0 and ua.`status` = '1' and ua.create_time <= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) and tu.`status` = 'ENABLE' and tu.invisible = '2' order by ua.create_time asc, ua.id asc

select ua.visit_user_id from user_visit ua left join t_user tu on tu.id = ua.visit_user_id where ua.del_flag = 0 and ua.`status` = '0' and tu.lately_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 60 DAY) and tu.lately_time <= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 DAY) and tu.`status` = 'ENABLE' and tu.invisible = '2' and ua.num>2 group by ua.visit_user_id order by ua.visit_user_id asc

SELECT c.id, c.create_time, c.modify_time, tu.nick_name, tu.phone, case c.type when '1' then tu2.nick_name when '2' then tu3.nick_name when '3' then tu4.nick_name end AS complaint_nick_name, case c.type when '1' then tu2.phone when '2' then tu3.phone when '3' then tu4.phone end as complaint_phone, ar.content as articleContent, ar.img as articleImg, ac.content as commentContent, c.type, c.content, c.`status` FROM complaint c LEFT JOIN t_user tu ON c.user_id = tu.id LEFT JOIN t_user tu2 ON tu2.id = c.complaint_id left join article ar on ar.id =c.complaint_id left join article_comment ac on ac.id=c.complaint_id left join t_user tu3 on ar.user_id=tu3.id left join t_user tu4 on ac.user_id=tu4.id
c.del_flag=0
and c.`status`=#{authStatus}
ORDER BY c.create_time desc, c.id DESC

select count(1) from user_visit uv left join t_user t on uv.user_id = t.id where t.del_flag = 0 and uv.del_flag = 0 and t.`status` = 'ENABLE' and uv.visit_user_id = #{ownerId} and uv.`status` = '0' order by uv.modify_time desc, uv.id desc

select u.avatar, u.nick_name,u.sex,rd.create_time,rd.id from register_distribution rd left join t_user u on rd.user_id = u.id where rd.type = 2 and rd.del_flag = 0 and rd.distribution_person_id = #{ownerId} order by rd.create_time desc, rd.id desc

select u.avatar, u.nick_name, u.id_auth, u.photo_auth, u.edu_auth from register_distribution rd left join t_user u on rd.user_id = u.id left join register_distribution rdd on rd.distribution_person_id = rdd.user_id where rd.type = 2 and rdd.distribution_person_id = #{ownerId} order by rd.create_time desc, rd.id desc

select (select count(1) from user_star us left join t_user tu on us.user_id = tu.id where us.del_flag = 0 and tu.del_flag = 0 and tu.`status` = 'ENABLE' and us.read_status = '0' and us.star_user_id = #{ownerId}) as unreadStarMe, (select count(1) from user_star us left join t_user tu on us.user_id = tu.id where us.del_flag = 0 and tu.del_flag = 0 and tu.`status` = 'ENABLE' and us.star_user_id = #{ownerId}) as starMe, (select count(1) from user_star us left join t_user tu on us.user_id = tu.id where us.del_flag = 0 and tu.del_flag = 0 and tu.`status` = 'ENABLE' and us.user_id = #{ownerId}) as myStar, (select count(1) from user_apply us left join t_user tu on us.user_id = tu.id where us.del_flag = 0 and tu.del_flag = 0 and tu.`status` = 'ENABLE' and us.apply_read_status = '0' and us.apply_user_id = #{ownerId}) as unreadApplyMe, (select count(1) from user_apply us left join t_user tu on us.user_id = tu.id where us.del_flag = 0 and tu.del_flag = 0 and tu.`status` = 'ENABLE' and us.apply_user_id = #{ownerId}) as applyMe, (select count(1) from user_apply us left join t_user tu on us.apply_user_id = tu.id where us.del_flag = 0 and tu.del_flag = 0 and tu.`status` = 'ENABLE' and us.apply_wait_status = '0' and us.user_id = #{ownerId}) as unreadMyApply, (select count(1) from user_apply us left join t_user tu on us.apply_user_id = tu.id where us.del_flag = 0 and tu.del_flag = 0 and tu.`status` = 'ENABLE' and us.user_id = #{ownerId}) as myApply, (select count(1) from user_visit uv left join t_user t on uv.user_id = t.id where t.del_flag = 0 and uv.del_flag = 0 and t.`status` = 'ENABLE' and uv.visit_user_id = #{ownerId} and uv.`status` = '0') as visitUnreadCount
select ST_Distance_Sphere( POINT(#{lonA}, #{latA}), POINT(#{lonB}, #{latB}) )

select (select IFNULL(count(1), 0) from register_distribution rd where rd.distribution_person_id = #{ownerId} and rd.type = 2 and rd.del_flag = 0) as inviteCount , (select IFNULL(sum(da.amount), 0) from distribution_amount da left join user_apply_order uao on da.order_id = uao.id where da.user_id = #{ownerId} and da.type = 1 and uao.`status` = 2 and da.del_flag = 0 and uao.del_flag = 0) as amount , (select IFNULL(ABS(sum(da.amount)) , 0) from distribution_amount da where da.user_id = #{ownerId} and da.type = 2 and da.del_flag = 0) as withdrawAmount , (select IFNULL(sum(da.amount) , 0) from distribution_amount da left join user_apply_order uao on da.order_id = uao.id where da.user_id = #{ownerId} and da.del_flag = 0 and uao.del_flag = 0 and da.type = 1 and uao.`status` = 2 and da.create_time <= DATE_SUB(NOW() , INTERVAL 3 DAY)) as surplusTotalAmount
